extracted.intended_audience: authors seeking representation (writers of adult/juvenile fiction & nonfiction; illustrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Submission guidelines for authors and illustrators seeking representation at the literary agency Writers House: what types of work they accept, how to submit, required query letter elements, and specific behaviors to avoid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of work accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Needs: Fiction and nonfiction for both adult and juvenile books. They also need illustrators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writers House is one of the largest literary agencies representing bestselling adult and children's authors and has over two dozen agents; submit work that fits those categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous queries to multiple Writers House agents
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't query two agents at Writers House simultaneously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit only to one Writers House agent at a time (the listing warns against querying multiple agents within the agency simultaneously).

rubrics_metrics.name: Excluded formats/materials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Screenplays are specifically excluded from submissions to Writers House according to this listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check agent-specific requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Visit the agents listing on Publishers Marketplace for specific requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual agents at the agency may have specific submission rules; consult their Publishers Marketplace listing before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred submission medium
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although a physical address is listed, the agency prefers to receive query letters by e-mail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required query letter contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Please e-mail us a query letter, which includes your credentials, an explanation of what makes your book unique and special, and a synopsis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure the query concisel y states your qualifications, the book's unique selling points, and includes a brief synopsis of the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Openness to career stage
rubrics_metrics.description: We are interested in and work with authors at all stages of their career.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writers House considers submissions from both new and established authors; indicate relevant experience or credentials in the query letter.
